pr_title: fix(core): error if NgZone.isInAngularZone is called with a noop zone
pr_body:
When the user opts into the noop `NgZone`, they usually still interact with the static methods on the non-noop class. This change adds a check to handle the case where zone.js hasn't been loaded.

Fixes #44784.
pr_comments: Adding a test for this is tricky, because it depends on zone.js not being included at all and I believe that all our unit tests include it automatically. Technically I can do `delete window.Zone` but that seems hacky and I'd rather avoid it. Since this is basically a null check and it has a comment already, I don't think that we'd easily regress from it.
This PR was merged into the repository by commit 215db7fbe6c91c43383a784b8d74c8063ce5c340.

review_comments: I was a little bit on the fence on how to handle this. I believe that this correct in terms of the mental model, but it will cause `NgZone.assertInAngularZone` to throw when the noop zone is enabled. We have one such assertion in the `ApplicationRef` constructor, although it only fires as a result of `onStable` emitting a value which won't happen with a noop zone. In theory it could happen if somebody emitted to our `EventEmitter`, but that is an anti-pattern.
